description: Romanian company annual accounts from the Ministry of Finance open data (data.gov.ro, CC BY 4.0, financial years 2019-2024, every published year in one call): balance sheet (fixed and current assets, inventories, receivables, cash, liabilities, provisions, equity, paid-up capital), income statement (net turnover, total income and expenses, gross and net profit or loss), average headcount, CAEN Rev. 2 activity class and filing format (abridged or full). Amounts in RON as published, null = not published, never zero. Legal persons only; a company with no published statement answers 404 without charge (banks, insurers, NBFIs and NGOs file in separate, unserved files). Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

cui.description: Romanian CUI / fiscal code, 1 to 10 digits, with or without the RO prefix, e.g. 412052 or RO412052

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_romanian_company_accounts

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Romanian annual accounts (Ministry of Finance)
